Date of Discovery: two weeks before the advisory was issued
Method of Attack: Steals sensitive files from infected users' browser and Discord application by accessing specific local storage files and exfiltrating data through a Discord webhook
Impacted Systems: Developer systems with Chrome, Opera, Yandex Browser, Brave, or Discord installed
Attack Vector: Typosquatting to mimic 'Fall Guys: Ultimate Knockout' game API and integrating the malicious library into projects
